name: withhammad-hyperframes
description: HyperFrames motion-graphic inserts (transparent overlays) for the Remotion Reel template. Main entry: render.sh <job_dir>.

scripts.dev: HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.155 preview
scripts.lint: HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.155 lint
scripts.check: HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.155 check
scripts.render: HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.155 render --format webm --quality high --output out/title_insert.webm
